description: This is a Java interface for message services within the OpenMRS notification module, defining methods for sending, creating, and preparing messages, as well as handling message templates.

classes.name: MessageService
classes.description: A Java interface declaring methods for sending, creating, and handling messages and templates within the OpenMRS notification framework.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a Message object, potentially to various recipients like user, role, or collection.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a Message object with specified parameters, including recipients, sender, subject, and message content.

methods.name: prepareMessage
methods.description: Prepares a Message object based on a template name and data map or a Template object.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific template by ID.

methods.name: getTemplatesByName
methods.description: Retrieves message templates matching a given name.
